Conversion rate optimisation (CRO) is the process of increasing the share of website visitors who enquire or buy, using analytics, user research, heatmaps and A/B testing. Khalid Farhan is a Dublin agency that runs CRO programmes for e-commerce and lead-generation sites, which multiplies the return on every other marketing channel. We work with businesses in Galway and across Ireland; most of the work is remote, and we meet Dublin clients in person.

WHAT IS INCLUDED IN OUR CRO SERVICE

CRO is the systematic process of increasing the percentage of your website visitors who take the action you want. We use a research-led approach — heatmaps, session recordings, user testing, and A/B experiments — to remove friction and increase conversions.
Retainers from €1,500 a month. Every engagement starts with a free audit, so you see the plan before you pay for anything.

QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR CRO
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
How much does CRO cost in Galway?
Retainers from €1,500 a month. The exact figure depends on the size of the opportunity and the amount of work, so we do a free audit first and quote from that. There is no charge for the audit.
Do you work with businesses in Galway?
Yes. We work with businesses in Galway and across Ireland. Most of the work is done remotely with regular calls and a monthly report; Dublin-based clients can meet us in person.
How much traffic do I need for CRO?
Reliable A/B testing requires at least 1,000 conversions per month to reach statistical significance in a reasonable timeframe. Below this, we focus on qualitative research and UX best practices.
How long do tests run?
Each test runs until statistical significance is reached — typically 2–8 weeks depending on traffic volume.
What's a typical conversion lift?
Results vary widely, but our clients typically see 15–40% uplift on tested pages. The compound effect across multiple tests is significant.
